description: CHARACTERIZATION FIXTURE for saga #811 (issue #816): this locks TODAY'S DEFECTIVE behaviour, not the correct behaviour. It must be FLIPPED to the correct expectation when the #814 `[spec]` ruling lands and #815 implements it; the wall exists now so the fix is provably a change. Fault shape A — an UNRESOLVABLE NAME in argument position. `check()` computes the right answer (`ol-unknown-command`, whose usual stage is `semantic` per spec/error-model.md:97) and `execute()` never consults it, so the statement is discarded whole with no diagnostic and no effect. The `execute()` half of the pair whose `-check` sibling reports `ol-unknown-command` for the same source. `execute()` emits the per-statement `instruction` marker and then NOTHING: no `print` event and no diagnostic. The empty `diagnostics` array here is the defect, and the absent `print` event is the learner-visible half of it.
